system.description:
The dwarves of Tenor Hold didn't wait for blackpowder to kill things at range. They solved it decades earlier with springs, gears and spite.

  • Reshapes: Firearm Proficiency (it covers repeating crossbows).
  • Clockwork Precision: a repeating crossbow has no Disadvantage on a Called Shot.
    • 9th level: your repeating crossbows hold 10 Shots.
  • Repeating crossbow: every Gunslinger feature that works with a firearm also works with a repeating crossbow, and its damage dice explode as a firearm's do. Firearm Proficiency covers it, Lightning Reload refills its magazine one round faster, and Quick Draw, Dead Eye, Dead Aim, Steady Shot, Trick Shot, Brace and Fire and Perfect Shot treat it as a firearm. It never misfires.
  • Engineer's Eye: Advantage on checks to identify, maintain, repair or modify mechanical ranged weapons, and you can field-repair any crossbow or firearm during a rest.
